I re-checked the schedule from my earlier answer against all 17 constraints, and it satisfies every one:

| Constraint | Check |
|---|---|
| Elif before Ben | 3 < 5 |
| Hana before Ann | 2 < 8 |
| Ann and Hana at least 3 apart | 6 apart |
| Hana before Ivo | 2 < 9 |
| Ben and Ivo at least 3 apart | 4 apart |
| Cara before Gus | 6 < 7 |
| One person between Dev and Hana | Slots 4 and 2, with Elif in slot 3 |
| Gus and Hana at least 3 apart | 5 apart |
| Dev before Gus | 4 < 7 |
| Dev and Ivo at least 3 apart | 5 apart |
| One person between Gus and Ivo | Slots 7 and 9, with Ann in slot 8 |
| One person between Ben and Elif | Slots 5 and 3, with Dev in slot 4 |
| Elif before Ivo | 3 < 9 |
| Ann and Ben at least 3 apart | 3 apart |
| Dev and Finn at least 3 apart | 3 apart |
| Hana immediately after Finn | Slots 2 and 1 |
| Cara before Ivo | 6 < 9 |

The team note's two options don't hold up:
- **Ann in slot 7, Gus in slot 8:** with Ivo in slot 9, Gus in slot 8 is adjacent to Ivo. That breaks "exactly one person between Gus and Ivo".
- **Ben in slot 6, Cara in slot 5:** this doesn't fit the same layout. With Ivo in 9 and Gus in 7, Elif must be in slot 4 for Ben to be in 6, which leaves Dev no valid slot. Dev has to be two slots from Hana and at least 3 from Finn.

My schedule stands.
